summary: Gores Holdings XI, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the effectiveness of its S-1 registration statement and the closing of its initial public offering. The SPAC sold 35,880,000 units at $10.00 per unit, including full exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment, for gross proceeds of $358.8 million. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one-fourth of one warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The company entered into customary SPAC agreements: underwriting, warrant, trust, registration rights, and private placement share purchase. These agreements and trust mechanics are standard for blank-check companies. What to watch: the SPAC now has two years to identify and complete a de-SPAC combination; risk-arb will focus on target speculation and sponsor alignment.
